bundle.shortDescription: A local AI studio for the Janas inference engine
bundle.longDescription: Janas Studio runs the Janas C inference engine on your own machine. Chat with local .jns models with streaming responses, tune temperature and top-p, browse and download GGUF models from Hugging Face, and compile them into the Janas .jns format with a live build console.
